subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Control UI chat picker accessibility slice after conflict resolution while leaving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82450 open for the broader linear workspace design?
rationale: The patch is focused and proven, but it changes user-facing accessibility wording, overlaps a larger open product/accessibility request, and carries a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Land narrow picker slice
options.body: Approve this focused session-position/current-session cue after exact-head required checks finish, and leave the broader workspace issue open.

options.title: Request UX or accessibility changes
options.body: Keep this PR open with specific copy, VoiceOver, or picker-behavior changes before merge.

options.title: Defer to broader design
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want picker-only accessibility slices before the broader linear workspace direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Land narrow picker slice
recommendation.body: Approve this focused session-position/current-session cue after exact-head required checks finish, and leave the broader workspace issue open.
